caption: The drawing depicts two objects on a plain, off-white background. The main object is a detailed illustration of a wooden tool, likely a historical or hand-crafted instrument, rendered in shades of brown, reddish-brown, and tan, with metallic gold accents at either end. The tool has a cylindrical handle, a gold-colored metal band, a spiraled central section, and ends in a bulbous tip with another gold band at the opposite end. The tool's surface texture is emphasized with shading, indicating a carved, twisted wooden design. To the left of the main object, there is a secondary, smaller drawing consisting of two elongated, narrow objects shown in outline and shaded form. These are colored in muted hues of gray and brown, and are labeled as “actual size.” Both objects are enclosed within a fine, rectangular border. There is a signature "T. Holloway" in the lower right corner.
title: Hand Tool
